operating_point.platform: CPU, GitHub runner (4 vCPU, its CPU model recorded per arm in cpu_<arm>.txt)
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: #259's gate-6 case: a sphere of radius 0.5 mm in a periodic tube of R = a/0.375 = 1.333 mm, 4 R long, the sphere's centre 0.2 R off the axis, water (mu 1e-3 Pa s, rho 1e3 kg/m^3), the flow node's steady step under Stokes, the band smooth_2h_0.3h, the interior 0.1h, Jacobi CG; 3 cells a radius (box 27 x 27 x 32, h 1.667e-4 m) and 6 (43 x 43 x 64, h 8.33e-5 m); the CG's default stop: 1e-8 in float64, 1e-5 at its rounding floor in float32, cap 5000
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: deterministic: no draws; each derivative is one number at one point. Derivatives: x (R_zz, the flux-free axial column of HeldSphere, in the lateral position), mu (R_zz in the viscosity; exactly R_zz/mu), drive (the held body's axial load at rest under g = 1 m/s^2, in g; exactly F/g)

prediction.basis: measured-before for x (gate 6, reverse mode, 3.4e-4); derived for mu and drive (R_zz is proportional to mu, the at-rest load to g; the residual 1e-8 bounds the rest)
prediction.why: the steady step is linear in mu's and g's right-hand sides; x carries the band's ripple within a cell (gate 5)

control.plant: plant=position_stop (the position held out of the lift, gate 6's plant): the jvp of x reads 0, 100 % off

gate_1_float64_forward.if_wrong: a forward-mode defect in float64: the cause is in the derivative, not the precision; stop and isolate it there
gate_1_float64_forward.cannot_discriminate_if: the central differences' spread over their steps exceeds the line (then x's comparison is the ripple's, not the derivative's)

prediction.basis: derived bound with guessed constants: the transpose solve's right-hand side is the load's penalty functional rho nu/K h^3 on the body, its norm set by the interior's resistivity (about 111/h^2 against the Laplacian's 6/h^2), so a relative stop of 1e-5 on it allows an error in the adjoint's fluid part about (sigma_in/lambda_min) sqrt(N_body) 1e-5, of order 0.1 at 3 cells and 1 at 6, which the gradient reads; the spike's 0.85 to 1.55 is a different case

Control transpose_cap 3/6 against 6/6 predicted: at 6 cells 3/3 (9.7e-3, 1.3e-2, 2.1e-2; transposes at the cap with 4.7e-4 to 9.6e-4), at 3 cells 0/3 against the 1e-4 line (1.8e-5, 4.0e-7, 4.3e-6): there the 40-iteration cap reaches 9e-6, so the plant is about float32's own stop and cannot discriminate (the gate's cannot_discriminate_if).
outcomes.gate_3_float32_forward: held (drive below its band). float32 jvp against float64's: x 5.5e-5, 1.6e-4; mu 2.2e-7, 1.6e-7; drive 5.4e-8, 7.1e-8. float32 jvp against its own CD (best step): x 4.3e-4, 5.6e-3; mu 9.6e-8, 2.7e-5; drive 4.5e-7, 9.2e-8: float32's CD is noise-bound at small steps (x at 6 cells 3.1e-2 at 0.003 h) and ripple-bound at large ones, so it checks x only to about 5e-3 at 6 cells; the cross-dtype comparison is the check.

outcomes.gate_7_derivative_defect: held. float64 at 1e-12: vjp against jvp 1.1e-11, 6.4e-12 (x), 2.5e-13, 1.5e-12 (mu), 2.0e-13, 1.3e-12 (drive); mu against R/mu 5.3e-14, 1.2e-11. No derivative defect.
outcomes.gate_8_stiffness: held. the gap against its own float64 (x, jvp / vjp): interior 0.01h 3.4e-3 / 4.1e-3 at 3 cells (x60 / x50 base); band depth halved 8.1e-5 / 1.4e-4 (x1.5 / x1.8); 6 cells against 3 x2.9 / x4.5.
outcomes.side_finding: the moved column's tangent solve in mu stagnates in every dtype (float32 1620 to 3160 iterations at 4e-2 to 9e-2, float64 1680 at 7e-8, float64 at 1e-12 1640 at 1e-3), flagged, while the derivative is right (against R/mu 1.5e-9 float64, 4.8e-7 float32): with no drive both the penalty's push and the operator are proportional to nu, so the tangent's right-hand side b' - A'u = (b - Au)/nu is the primal's residual, which the CG cannot reduce relative to itself. A study's derivative in viscosity of a body-driven, undriven Stokes flow would warn of a stop short and recheck a right derivative: loud, not silent.
outcomes.gate_9_stiff_interior_at_6_cells: held for x and the forward mode, missed above the band for mu's and the drive's reverse mode. float32 against float64 at the same setting (0.01h, 6 cells): x jvp 1.65e-2 (its moved tangent solve flagged stagnated at 9.8e-4), x vjp 3.22e-2 (every transpose solve converged, 465 to 482 iterations at 9e-6: no flag); mu jvp 3.9e-5, vjp 1.65e-3; drive jvp 2.8e-6, vjp 1.61e-3 (bands 1e-6 to 1e-3). float64's own: vjp against jvp 1.5e-7 (x), 2.9e-7 (mu), 3.7e-7 (drive). The reverse-mode gap at this setting is past the 1e-2 line this probe called right, with no flag: the refusal (drag.penalty-float32-reverse) follows from it.
